catalogueTitle: Traveller misses a connection; airline recovery is not good enough
note: Chloe Martin (ait-draft-09, SYD origin, hackathon finalist: lab + finals on 30 Sep, awards on 2 Oct) reports mid-travel that her SYD departure left hours late, she missed her KUL connection, and the airline moved her to a next-morning flight. Northstar reconciles the report against the expected trip state and determines the airline's replacement arrival (30 Sep 09:20) leaves only ~2h before the hackathon lab and risks the hotel no-show, rest and finalist prep — recovery not good enough. A same-evening alternative (MN224, landside 21:40 on 29 Sep) exists but its arrival shift exceeds the 3h delegated-authority bound, so HUMAN_AGENT approval is required. Simulated seam: airline state artifacts are SIMULATED_EXTERNAL_EVENT; the traveller message is TRAVELLER_SUPPLIED_SYNTHETIC; nothing here is LIVE.

affectedTravellers.reason: Airline rebooking lands 2026-09-30T09:20+08:00: ~1h55m before the hackathon lab (11:15) and ~5h50m before the REQUIRED/FIXED hackathon finals (15:10); hotel night of 29 Sep risks no-show release; no rest window; finalist prep uncompressed but unbuffered.

expectedReasoningHooks: Conversational ingestion: extract factual claims (missed connection, airline rebook, tomorrow-morning arrival, finals commitment) from a natural traveller message without treating them as authoritative provider state.
Reconciliation: compare the traveller's report with expected trip state (baseline itinerary) and the provider's involuntary-reroute record; missing evidence stays UNKNOWN, never fabricated.

Downstream invalidation by the airline replacement: hotel no-show cutoff (29 Sep 18:00), pre-booked airport transfer for 29 Sep 17:50 arrival, required rest before a REQUIRED/FIXED on-stage commitment, badge pickup window.
Deterministic rejection of the provider recovery: arrival 30 Sep 09:20 fails the 12h programme-critical buffer (finalist = REQUIRED/FIXED) and leaves no margin for immigration/baggage variance.

Recovery with authority: MN224 (29 Sep 20:30 -> 21:40, 3 seats) restores a viable arrival; arrival shift vs baseline is 3h50m, exceeding the delegatedAuthority 3h bound -> HUMAN_AGENT per rule-ait-flight-change-approval; supplier-caused, so no cost to the traveller.
